sh:select Literal("
                    PREFIX nltl: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#>
                    PREFIX qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/>
                    PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
                    SELECT $this
                    WHERE {
                        $this nltl:continuousSurfaceProjectedArea ?continuousNode ;
                              nltl:discontinuousSurfaceProjectedArea ?discontinuousNode .
                        ?continuousNode qudt:numericValue ?continuousValue .
                        ?discontinuousNode qudt:numericValue ?discontinuousValue .
                        FILTER (
                            ABS(?discontinuousValue - (?continuousValue * 1.05))
                            >
                            (ABS(?continuousValue * 1.05) * 0.000001 + 0.000000001)
                        )
                    }
                ") ], [ sh:message Literal("discontinuousSurfaceStaticMoment must equal continuousSurfaceStaticMoment multiplied by 1.10 within a relative tolerance of 1e-6, with an absolute fallback of 1e-9.") ; sh:select Literal("

                    SELECT $this

                        $this nltl:continuousSurfaceStaticMoment ?continuousNode ;
                              nltl:discontinuousSurfaceStaticMoment ?discontinuousNode .
                        ?continuousNode qudt:numericValue ?continuousValue .
                        ?discontinuousNode qudt:numericValue ?discontinuousValue .
                        FILTER (
                            ABS(?discontinuousValue - (?continuousValue * 1.10))
                            >

                        )
                    }

blocker.detail: The negative rejects and the intended-only repair passes, but one or more reported logical/SPARQL/complex-path failures lack a reviewed semantic correspondence. No strict credit is inferred from verdicts alone.

likely_cause.detail: The independently valid intended-only counterfactual still rejects or violation meaning is not established. Reports are saved; no context-vs-generator cause is invented.
